item.title: Gunman opens fire, takes hostages in Hat Yai school in Thailand
item.description: ALBAWABA - Gunmen crashed into one of the schools in Hat Yai in southern Thailand, opened fire against children and took hostages, local media reported Wednesday.A gunman who fired shots at Patongprathankiriwat School has been arrested by the Thai police. All the people who were held hostage have been freed.An 18-year-old man entered the school in Songkhla Province's Hat Yai with a gun, officials detailed. item.title: Russian village evacuated over a fire in military facility
item.description: ALBAWABA - A Russian village was evacuated in Volgograd region after a fire that broke out inside a military facility, the regional governor announced Thursday. Russia detailed that it repelled a missile attack in the Volgograd region, but debris caused a fire at a military facility. item.title: Highguard team faces mass layoffs, designer says
item.description: ALBAWABA - Only weeks after its release, Highguard has allegedly lost most of its staff members after the game failed to reach a respectable playerbase. Level designer Alex Graner posted on LinkedIn that he was laid off, along with most of the team at Wildlight Entertainment. He added, "This one really stings as there was a lot of unreleased content I was really looking forward to that I and others designed for Highguard."
